name: app-serif-italic-persona-cards-on-dashed-path
title: Primary and Secondary Personas on a Dashed Path
whatItIs: A white page titled 'Main Issues' with two tilted portrait cards hanging from a curving dashed path, each with a role pill, an italic serif name, a quote with key words darker, and three icon pill tags for feelings.
whatItMeans: Portraits hanging like tags along a path make personas feel like a story, and italic names add warmth.
techniques: Tilted framed portraits pinned to a dashed path
Italic serif names beside sans quotes
Key phrases darker within a grey quote

vocabulary.definition: The main person the product is designed for.
Someone affected by or supporting the primary user.
A small tag naming a feeling with an icon.
